description: This is a PHP unit test class for the MaintenanceDao component within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It includes setup for test fixtures and a test method for extracting data based on employee number.

classes.name: MaintenanceDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing MaintenanceDao functions within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the MaintenanceDao instance and populates test data fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testExtractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests the extraction of employee data by employee number to verify correct retrieval of employee information.
